notes: Free Edge voice works again in Europe (Microsoft moved its voice server on 10 October, the app now uses the new one). Practice and qualifying: going back to the garage no longer wipes your lap times and live delta or repeats the practice plan, restart detection now only applies to races. LMU and iRacing: go go go now comes at the green flag, not when the formation lap starts. Speech recognition: the local recognizer now restarts properly after switching the model size.
